description: This file defines the PipelineRunner class responsible for managing the execution of pipeline tasks, including signal handling, garbage collection, and lifecycle management.

classes.name: PipelineRunner
classes.description: Manages the execution of pipeline tasks with lifecycle and signal handling, providing methods for running, stopping, cancelling, and cleanup.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the PipelineRunner with optional signal handling and event loop configuration.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Executes a pipeline task to completion, handling cancellation and cleanup.

methods.name: stop_when_done
methods.description: Schedules all running tasks to stop after their current processing.

methods.name: _cancel
methods.description: Internal method to cancel all tasks.

methods.name: _setup_sigint
methods.description: Sets up signal handler for SIGINT for graceful shutdown.

methods.name: _setup_sigterm
methods.description: Sets up signal handler for SIGTERM for graceful shutdown.

methods.name: _sig_handler
methods.description: Handles interrupt signals by initiating task cancellation.

methods.name: _sig_cancel
methods.description: Performs cancellation of tasks upon signal reception.

methods.name: _gc_collect
methods.description: Performs garbage collection and logs the results.
